page_title: Maintenance vs. implementation under a fixed weekly budget
page_subtitle: Same codebase, same backlog, same weekly budget: a group that never maintains vs. a group that maintains when metrics cross thresholds
sim_disclaimer: Simulated results reflect only the assumed coefficients; they cannot show whether the premise holds.
real_disclaimer: Small sample ({reps} reps per group): results are descriptive, with no claim of statistical significance.

metric_names.avg_input_tokens: Avg input tokens per implementation task

headline.overspend_note: item overspends; week overspends in parentheses

conclusion.template: {hyp}: in 8 weeks the no-maintenance group completed {a} items and the maintenance group {b} ({scope}). Per-item cost, late vs. early: {r1} for the no-maintenance group ({trend}), {r2} for the maintenance group. {verdict}
conclusion.verdict_more: In these data the maintenance group delivered more.
conclusion.verdict_less: In these data the maintenance group delivered less.
conclusion.verdict_equal: In these data both groups delivered the same.

sections.single_run_note: With Rep set to All, this view shows rep 1.

cost.title: 1. Implementation cost per item, by week
cost.read: Each week's (implementation + debugging) spend ÷ items completed that week. The line is the mean over reps; the band spans min to max. Reps that completed nothing that week are left out.

cum.title: 2. Cumulative items completed
cum.read: Backlog items that passed acceptance, cumulative to the end of each week. Higher and steeper means more delivered.

spend.title: 3. Where each week's budget went
spend.read: Two bars per week: left the no-maintenance group, right the maintenance group (mean over reps). The black line is the weekly budget. The red hatched part above it is a week overspend; it is deducted from the next week's budget, so that bar ends below the line.

metrics.title: 4. Metrics by week
metrics.read: One chart per metric, measured at the start of each week (week 0 is the baseline). The grey dotted line is the trigger threshold. A triangle marks a week in which the maintenance group ran a maintenance agent because of this metric; the number is how many reps triggered.

forecast.title: 5. Forecast at week start vs. items completed
forecast.read: Hollow points: the forecast at the start of the week (this week's implementation budget ÷ average cost per item so far). Solid points: items actually completed. The gap is the forecast error.

timeline.title: 6. Task timeline
timeline.read: One row per week, one block per task. Width is cost, colour is task type. The vertical line is the week's budget; anything past it is a week overspend. Solid blocks passed, hatched blocks failed, ↺ marks an item that was rolled back. Hover for details.
